name: Activation Status 3
definition: Specifies the status of a debtor activation.

OriginalBusinessInstruction.name: Original Business Instruction
OriginalBusinessInstruction.definition: Unique identification of the original instruction.

Status.name: Status
Status.definition: Provides detailed information on the status of the request.

StatusReason.name: Status Reason
StatusReason.definition: Specifies the reason for the status of the debtor activation request.

OriginalActivationReference.name: Original Activation Reference
OriginalActivationReference.definition: Provides the reference of the original activation request.

EffectiveActivationDate.name: Effective Activation Date
EffectiveActivationDate.definition: Effective date when the debtor has been activated.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.

OriginalActivationPresenceRule.definition: When Status/Code is "Accepted" then OriginalActivationReference must be present.
